info.name: Schedence API (local)
info.description: Every endpoint of the Identity Service and the Academic Data Service, with automatic checks. Read docs/testing/API_TESTING.md first. Run folders 00-09 in order (Collection Runner works); M-folders need manual steps (M5 needs a System Admin token).

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Run first in every test run: picks a new random suffix so codes, staff numbers and e-mails are unique.

item.name: Start a new test run (new suffix)
01 Health (no token)
item.description: Liveness and SELECT 1 database checks. No authentication.

item.name: 02 Identity - current user (Institution Admin token)
item.description: Uses the collection OAuth token (sign in as the Institution Admin).

exec: pm.test("has INSTITUTION_ADMIN", function () { pm.expect(body.roles.some(r => r.role_code === "INSTITUTION_ADMIN"), "has INSTITUTION_ADMIN").to.be.true; });
pm.test("no platform role", function () { pm.expect(body.platform_roles.length === 0, "no platform role").to.be.true; });

pm.test("can create users in the institution", function () { pm.expect(body.institutions.some(i => i.institution_id === pm.collectionVariables.get("institutionId") && i.permissions.includes("identity:users:create")), "can create users in the institution").to.be.true; });
pm.test("6 system roles", function () { pm.expect(body.length === 6, "6 system roles").to.be.true; });

pm.test("no academic positions as roles", function () { pm.expect(!body.some(r => ["HOD", "HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT", "PROGRAM_COORDINATOR", "DEAN"].includes(r.code)), "no academic positions as roles").to.be.true; });

item.name: 04 Identity - user management
item.description: Creates two real accounts. Each POST /users sends a real Cognito invitation e-mail (plus-addressed, so it reaches your inbox) and counts toward Cognito's 50 e-mails/day.

exec: pm.test("finds the lecturer", function () { pm.expect(body.total === 1, "finds the lecturer").to.be.true; });
pm.test("only lecturers", function () { pm.expect(body.items.every(u => u.roles.some(r => r.role_code === "LECTURER")), "only lecturers").to.be.true; });
pm.test("same user", function () { pm.expect(body.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("userId"), "same user").to.be.true; });
pm.test("awaiting first sign-in", function () { pm.expect(body.cognito_status === "FORCE_CHANGE_PASSWORD", "awaiting first sign-in").to.be.true; });
pm.test("e-mail verified", function () { pm.expect(body.cognito_email_verified === true, "e-mail verified").to.be.true; });
pm.test("one completed record", function () { pm.expect(body.length === 1 && body[0].status === "COMPLETED", "one completed record").to.be.true; });
pm.test("synced to Cognito", function () { pm.expect(body.cognito_sync === "ok", "synced to Cognito").to.be.true; });
pm.test("only LECTURER", function () { pm.expect(body.roles.length === 1 && body.roles[0].role_code === "LECTURER", "only LECTURER").to.be.true; });
pm.test("Cognito disabled too", function () { pm.expect(body.cognito_sync === "ok", "Cognito disabled too").to.be.true; });
pm.test("Cognito disabled", function () { pm.expect(body.cognito_enabled === false, "Cognito disabled").to.be.true; });
pm.test("history recorded", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(e => e.action === "user.disabled") && body.items.some(e => e.action === "user.role_revoked"), "history recorded").to.be.true; });

item.description: Each request must be refused with the stated status and error code.

exec: pm.test("error code INVALID_TOKEN", function () { pm.expect(body.error && body.error.code).to.eql("INVALID_TOKEN"); });

item.name: Disable a position that is in use -> 409
M1 Manual - as the Lecturer (appointments are not login roles)
item.description: Needs lecturerToken: complete the test Lecturer's first sign-in, get an access token for that user (see the guide) and paste it into the lecturerToken variable. The Lecturer is now Head of Department in the Academic Data Service, yet keeps only LECTURER access.

exec: pm.test("only LECTURER", function () { pm.expect(body.roles.length >= 1 && body.roles.every(r => r.role_code === "LECTURER"), "only LECTURER").to.be.true; });
pm.test("no admin permissions", function () { pm.expect(body.institutions.every(i => i.permissions.length === 0), "no admin permissions").to.be.true; });

item.name: M2 Manual - disabled account is blocked immediately
item.description: Uses the Institution Admin token for disable/enable and lecturerToken for the blocked calls. The Lecturer's token is still unexpired; the API rejects it anyway.

item.name: M3 Manual - Identity Service down (fail closed)
item.description: Stop the launcher, start only the Academic service (python scripts\run_services.py --only academic), wait 20 seconds (read permissions are cached for 15 s), then send.

item.name: Academic call while Identity is down -> 503
M4 Manual - Cognito failure, retry and cancel
item.description: Simulates an AWS outage. Stop the launcher, set AWS_PROFILE=schedence-broken in .env, start again, run the first two requests; restore AWS_PROFILE=schedence-identity, restart, run the rest.

item.name: Create user while Cognito is unreachable -> 503

exec: pm.test("failed record listed", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(p => p.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("failedProvisioningId")), "failed record listed").to.be.true; });

item.name: M5 Manual - as the System Admin (institutions and their admins)
item.description: Needs systemAdminToken: bootstrap a System Admin with a dedicated e-mail (see the guide), get an access token for that user and paste it into systemAdminToken. Creates a TEST_ institution and its admin (one real invitation e-mail), proves the System Admin has no access inside institutions, and ends with the TEST_ institution disabled (institutions are never deleted).

exec: pm.test("no institution roles", function () { pm.expect(body.roles.length === 0, "no institution roles").to.be.true; });
pm.test("lists the main institution", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(i => i.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("institutionId")), "lists the main institution").to.be.true; });

pm.test("INSTITUTION_ADMIN there", function () { pm.expect(body.user.roles.some(r => r.role_code === "INSTITUTION_ADMIN" && r.institution_id === pm.collectionVariables.get("testInstitutionId")), "INSTITUTION_ADMIN there").to.be.true; });
pm.test("lists the new admin", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(u => u.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("testInstitutionAdminId")), "lists the new admin").to.be.true; });

item.name: System Admin: GET /users -> 403 (no access inside institutions)
System Admin: add admin to a disabled institution -> 409

exec: pm.test("platform events only", function () { pm.expect(body.items.every(e => e.action.startsWith("platform.")), "platform events only").to.be.true; });
pm.test("institution created", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(e => e.action === "platform.institution_created"), "institution created").to.be.true; });
pm.test("admin created", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(e => e.action === "platform.institution_admin_created"), "admin created").to.be.true; });
